repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a 30-second sustained wait (`wait(..., for: 30 SEC)`). With a 1000 ms wrapper period, the candidate fires at t=29000 ms (29 ticks), whereas the IR requires the action at t=30000 ms (30 ticks). The candidate uses `hold_ticks >= 30` but starts counting at t=0, reaching the threshold after 29 iterations (29 seconds). To match the IR, the threshold must be 31 so the action fires on the 31st tick (30 seconds elapsed), or the logic must be adjusted to count 30 full ticks before firing. Given the structure, setting the threshold to 31 ensures the action occurs at t=30000 ms.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed `hold_ticks >= 30` to `hold_ticks >= 31`. With `period=1000`, the first check is at t=0 (tick 1). The condition becomes true when `hold_ticks` reaches 31, which happens at t=30000 ms (tick 31), matching the IR's 30-second duration requirement.
